claims: The 2026 WNBA Draft was held on April 13, 2026.
Dallas Wings selected Azzi Fudd (UConn) with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Toronto Tempo and Portland Fire are expansion teams that joined the fold in the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Toronto Tempo picked 6th in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Portland Fire picked 7th in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Minnesota Lynx (from Chicago) selected Olivia Miles (TCU) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Seattle Storm (from Los Angeles) selected Awa Fam Thiam (Spain) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Washington Mystics selected Lauren Betts (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Chicago Sky (from Connecticut) selected Gabriela Jaquez (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Toronto Tempo selected Kiki Rice (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Portland Fire selected Iyana Martín Carrión (Spain) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Golden State Valkyries selected Flau'jae Johnson (LSU) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Golden State Valkyries' pick of Flau'jae Johnson (LSU) was traded to Seattle.
Seattle acquired the No. 8 pick (Flau'jae Johnson) from Golden State Valkyries.
Washington Mystics (from Seattle) selected Angela Dugalić (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Indiana Fever selected Raven Johnson (South Carolina) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Washington Mystics (from New York) selected Cotie McMahon (Ole Miss) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Connecticut Sun (from Phoenix) selected Nell Angloma (France) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Atlanta Dream selected Madina Okot (South Carolina) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Seattle Storm (from Las Vegas) selected Taina Mair (Duke) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Connecticut Sun (from Minnesota) selected Gianna Kneepkens (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Toronto Tempo and Portland Fire participated in their first draft.
Five UCLA Bruins were selected in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
